carrier_name: Mutual of Omaha (United of Omaha Life Insurance Company)

must_contain: United of Omaha Life Insurance Company

extraction_notes:
This is a multi-product Mutual of Omaha "Group Insurance Proposal" document (quote/doc ID shown at top of each page, e.g. 24317905). Each product gets its own section starting with a bold section header (e.g. "LONG-TERM DISABILITY INSURANCE") and an "Alternate" number. Sections include Basic Life/AD&D, Voluntary Life/AD&D, Voluntary STD, LTD, Voluntary Dental, Voluntary Critical Illness, Voluntary Hospital Indemnity, Voluntary Accident, Voluntary Vision - only extract LTD per instructions.

LTD LAYOUT: Found under "LONG-TERM DISABILITY INSURANCE" header. There is only ONE class/plan in this document (Class 1: All Eligible Employees). The "BENEFIT SUMMARY" table lists: Benefit Percentage (e.g. 60%), Maximum Benefit (e.g. $6,000), Guarantee Issue (same as max here), Elimination Period (e.g. 90 days), Accumulation Period, Own Occ Definition, Benefit Duration (e.g. "RBD to SSNRA" = to retirement/SS Normal Retirement Age), Integration method, Pre-Existing Condition, Mental/Drug limitations, Minimum Benefit.

The actual RATE is found later on a separate page under "COST SUMMARY" table with columns: Number of Lives | Covered Monthly Payroll | Monthly Rate | Total Monthly Premium | Total Annual Premium. The Monthly Rate is expressed as "$X.XXX (Per $100 of Monthly Covered Payroll)" - this is the flat rate per unit to extract. Only one row (one class) for LTD in this doc - do not miss it thinking there's more than one row.

Contribution structure and number of eligible employees are given in a "PARTICIPATION ASSUMPTIONS" table (Minimum Participation %, Number of Eligible Employees, Contribution Structure e.g. "Non-Contributory" = 100% employer paid or "100% employee paid").

Note: Basic Life/AD&D and Voluntary Life/AD&D in this carrier's docs use per-$1,000 flat/age-banded rates (not LTD) - ignore those per instructions unless asked. STD in this carrier's docs is rated per $10 of weekly benefit by age band (age-banded, not flat) - do not confuse with LTD's flat per-$100-of-payroll rate. Total products/sections in this specimen doc: 9, but only LTD (1 row) was extracted per task instructions.
